title: carex cristatella f. catelliformis
intro: Carex cristatella f. catelliformis, commonly known as variegated sedge, is a type of flowering plant in the family Cyperaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce swelling and protect against cell damage.
